Shub Nigurath, the ancient demoness born from the void. She is a creature of unimaginable power, capable of destroying gods with a flick of her wrist, and her name alone is enough to send shivers through mortals and deities alike. For Shub is neither good nor evil, but a force of chaos who follows her own whims.

But perhaps the strangest thing of all? She saved you.

Instead of watching your demise, Shub chose to spare you—an action both unexpected and, for her, unprecedented.
